source: Binance Vision USD-M metrics daily archives + 1m futures klines
timestamp_policy: 2024 historical metrics create_time labels treated as end-of-period; as-of join only, signal uses metrics timestamp <= decision minute; entry next minute open.
splits: Chronological 50% train / 20% validation / 30% untouched OOS by matched minute rows. Thresholds fit on train only.
costs: Entry and exit fee each 2/5/8 bp; entry and exit slippage each 2 bp. 1x, 100% equity per trade, non-overlapping.
limitations: Metrics are 5-minute aggregates/snapshots; no tick-level position changes.
No funding cashflow or liquidation simulation in this diagnostic.
Historical metrics definitions and timestamp semantics require effective-date caution; this sample is 2024.
Adverse drawdown uses 1m high/low path during each held trade, not exchange liquidation engine.
